responsibility: Implements MIPS common option normalization for a small set of architectural and ABI-related switches. It establishes the combined default target, CPU, endianness, and divide-check flags, clears cached helper names or mutually exclusive floating-point mode bits in response to options like -mno-flush-func, -mfp32, -mfp64, and -mfpxx, and leaves the backend with a consistent target_flags state before detailed MIPS option override and code generation.
